provider: Wasserstraßen- und Schifffahrtsverwaltung des Bundes (WSV) / PEGELONLINE

request_contract.parameter_rules: Only the frozen Dresden station UUID 70272185-b2b3-4178-96b8-43bea330dcae is allowed for this contract. resolve_station_metadata adds includeTimeseries=true and must not request currentMeasurement or measurement values. Callers cannot supply a host, arbitrary path, headers or unrestricted query parameters.

response_contract.format: PEGELONLINE REST-v2 station JSON parsed by scripts/parse_pegelonline_metadata.py.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The metadata response must resolve station 501060 / DRESDEN / ELBE and exactly one Q / ABFLUSS_ROHDATEN series in m³/s. The existing parser rejects currentMeasurement, station drift, Q-semantic drift, non-finite coordinates and incompatible sampling intervals.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No repository-specific rate-limit assumption is made. Use one bounded metadata request for a probe and respect current provider documentation before increasing request volume.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Live station metadata can change operationally. Every accepted probe receipt must record retrieval time, response byte count and SHA-256; frozen scientific identity is reviewed separately.

rights_and_policy.notes: The paired source review records PEGELONLINE webservice/download data under Datenlizenz Deutschland – Zero – Version 2.0. Repository admission remains metadata-only; this contract does not authorize committing acquired measurement bytes.

expected_evidence: HTTP/provider success status without unsafe payload logging
strict parser result for the frozen station/Q metadata contract

notes: This is the first concrete OpenCatastrophe source-access contract. It covers the already implemented metadata-only REST path, not the separate long-term target-value download. The long-term JSON acquisition route remains governed by the existing preregistered Dresden evidence workflow and requires exact byte-level acquisition receipts before use.
